*Example results from running the tutorial on the IBA COI dataset `IBA_CO1_homogenate_2019_SE`, used here to validate the approach against previously known results, plus a bonus example combining it with a second dataset (`IBA_CO1_lysate_2019_SE`).*

---

### Sampling sites across Sweden

*Map of the IBA sampling sites, coloured by habitat type.*

![](figures/map.png)

---

### Community structure (PCoA)

*Principal Coordinates Analysis (Spearman-based dissimilarity) of cluster-level community composition, coloured by year-day, habitat and latitude, plus variance explained per axis.*

![](figures/pcoa.png)

---

### Bonus: combining datasets

*Same analysis after merging in a second dataset (`IBA_CO1_lysate_2019_SE`, downsampled to match), with a fourth panel coloured by extraction method. Homogenate and lysate samples are thoroughly mixed — extraction method explains only ~0.3% of the variance in community composition (PERMANOVA), compared to ~5-6% for habitat.*

![](figures/pcoa_combined.png)
